title: From Instructions to Intrinsic Human Values — A Survey of Alignment Goals for Big Models
base_benchmarks: Pew Research Center's Global Attitudes surveys (GAS)
findings: The paper cites research indicating that when probed with value surveys (which include questions on religion), current LLMs exhibit a geopolitical bias towards opinions from the USA, Europe, and South America.
references: 2021. World values survey wave 7 (2017-2022).
